title: [Shopify] Migrate Shopify Connector to Expiring Offline Access Tokens
summary: The Shopify Connector now supports Shopify's expiring offline access tokens with automatic refresh-token rotation. The connector transparently migrates legacy non-expiring tokens to expiring tokens during API calls and refreshes tokens before expiry, with a user notification when the refresh token expires.
key_points: New Token Expires At and Refresh Token Expires At fields on Shpfy Registered Store New; the refresh token is kept in IsolatedStorage
New installs request expiring tokens, and legacy non-expiring tokens are migrated once per shop when an API call runs
EnsureValidAccessToken is called from GetAccessToken, so every API call refreshes a token that is close to expiry
An unexpected 401 response forces a single token refresh followed by one retry
The Shop Card shows a reconnect notification when the refresh token has expired
quote: As of December 2025, Shopify supports expiring offline access tokens with refresh-token rotation.
